items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion generally available for multi-model orchestration
facts: GitHub Copilot Fusion is generally available.
In the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Copilot Fusion Max scored 60, within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max.
It delivered that result at about half the average API cost per task, using about half as many tokens and taking about 40% less time per task.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows generally available
facts: GitHub Agentic Workflows, an open source project from GitHub Next, is now generally available.
With agentic workflows, you can automate reasoning-based tasks like issue triage, CI failure analysis, documentation updates, and test writing by using coding agents inside GitHub Actions.
Define your automation in natural language Markdown files, and GitHub Agentic Workflows compiles them into standard Actions YAML.

items.title: Replit releases ViBench 2.0 long-horizon software benchmark
facts: Today we’re releasing ViBench 2.0, a benchmark for long-horizon software development.
ViBench 2.0 has seventeen products, 241 feature requests, and 544 test plans.
The best models, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, and Opus 5.5, pass all test plans in only 49-65% of their builds.

items.title: GitHub announces Copilot Automations
facts: Every developer has work they shouldn’t have to repeat. Define the job once, then run it on demand, on a schedule, or in response to activity in GitHub or a connected service.

items.title: GitHub introduces Copilot Projects
facts: Copilot Projects gives you one place to see where the work stands and direct what Copilot takes on next.
Copilot Projects are now in public preview.

items.title: Artificial Analysis benchmarks Copilot Fusion Max near Opus 5.5 at half cost
facts: GitHub has released Copilot Fusion in GitHub Copilot, which orchestrates between Anthropic and OpenAI models.
It scores 2 points below Opus 5.5 in Claude Code at half the Cost per Task in the Coding Agent Index
Copilot Fusion in GitHub Copilot costs $5.59 per task, versus $11.42 for Claude Code with Opus 5.5 (max).

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.312 released with OIDC and click-to-send improvements
facts: Added oidc.user_id_claim to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than sub, such as Microsoft Entra ID's oid
Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does

items.title: Runway Dev plugin available for OpenAI Codex
facts: Runway Dev is now on Codex
One plugin install gives Codex everything it needs to build Runway’s API into your app.
